$comment: Classification of Cloudflare/Vercel workspaces. Checked by tools/check-workers.mjs. railsBacked: OpenNext apps that fetch from Rails — they own a src/lib/rails-client.ts copy and declare the VPC Service binding at the top level (production) and in env.development (remote), never in env.test. contentSurface: OpenNext apps that do not talk to Rails and must carry no VPC binding at all. standalone: Hono apex workers, no Rails — they own the root domain and must survive a Rails outage. external: Vercel-hosted, no wrangler config. Lifecycle model: adr/009.
$vpcServicesComment: One VPC Service id per LIFECYCLE environment. env.test intentionally has none — see $testHasNoVpc. Verify with `wrangler vpc service list`.

vpcServices.$developmentComment: Bound to the development tunnel (1d501e9a-62f7-4c0d-ba5e-a26e3f10088f), terminating on a developer's machine. Used by `pnpm preview` through a remote binding.
vpcServices.$productionComment: BOOTSTRAP STATE — currently the SAME id as development. See $productionIsBootstrap.

$productionIsBootstrapComment: TRUE means production deliberately points at the DEVELOPMENT VPC Service because production Rails on AWS does not exist yet — verified 2026-08-22, the account holds exactly one VPC Service. Adopted 2026-08-22. While true, a deployed production Worker's Rails traffic leaves the production network and terminates on a developer's machine through the development tunnel, and production /rails-health reports ok for the wrong reason. TO EXIT: (1) create the production tunnel beside production Rails and a production VPC Service on it; (2) set vpcServices.production to the new id; (3) replace service_id in the fifteen top-level vpc_services blocks; (4) set this flag to false. tools/check-workers.mjs and test/rails-connection-invariants.test.ts then REQUIRE the two ids to differ, so the guardrail is suspended rather than deleted. No application, transport, or development-environment change is needed.
$testHasNoVpcComment: env.test carries no vpc_services, and that absence is an invariant. `vpc_services` being non-inheritable means an environment that needs it must state it explicitly — NOT that every environment must carry every production binding. The test architecture has no Rails dependency.
